chunks: Sama'ah ibn Mihrān asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about the time of Salat al-Layl during travel.
So he said: “From the time you perform al-'Atamah until dawn breaks.”

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel, meaning the state of journeying
key_terms.الْعَتَمَةَ: the night prayer, referring here to 'Isha
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed during the night
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time or period for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the time for Salat al-Layl during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith states the time for Salat al-Layl in travel. The Imam عليه السلام explains that its time begins after the 'Isha prayer and continues until the emergence of dawn.
